stories.title: Die Huthi erobern die Meerenge Bab al-Mandab nicht nur zur Schützenhilfe Irans. Sie wollen ihre eigene Kasse mit Milliarden füllen

en.title: The Huthis are conquering the Bab al-Mandab Strait not only to support Iran. They want to fill their own coffers with billions
en.summary: The Houthis have built a shadow and smuggling economy over years and seek to expand their financial gains through recent military operations in the strait. Their growing wealth may reduce their dependence on Iranian support and control.

stories.title: Er ist im Visier der Schweizer, Maduro liess ihn verhaften, doch dann verschwand er: Welche Rolle spielt der Cousin von Venezuelas neuem Öl-Zaren?

en.title: He is in Swiss sights, Maduro had him arrested, but then he disappeared: What role does the cousin of Venezuela's new oil tycoon play?
en.summary: The Trump administration recently intervened with Swiss prosecutors investigating Alejandro Betancourt, who became Venezuela's key dealmaker. Prosecutors are also examining his cousin's involvement.

stories.title: Er wirkte blass und distanziert. Trotzdem hatte der neue Apple-Chef John Ternus einen guten ersten Auftritt

en.title: He appeared pale and distant. Still, new Apple CEO John Ternus had a good first appearance
en.summary: John Ternus, known for Apple's high-margin hardware, made his debut as CEO by presenting a foldable iPhone, marking a successful first public appearance despite his reserved demeanor.

en.title: Speculators will test the resolve of US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent
en.summary: Former hedge fund manager Scott Bessent challenged investors this week to bet against his market interventions, a stance that could lead to significant consequences.

en.title: Bitcoin celebrates a comeback – or is it just a flash in the pan?
en.summary: Bitcoin's price has risen sharply in a short period, with analysts considering two very different scenarios for what may happen next.

en.title: The eternal search for relevance: How smartphone forecasts and black turf are supposed to transform athletics
en.summary: World Athletics is creating an innovative format called the Ultimate Championship to attract younger audiences to track and field. Other sports have faced similar challenges in achieving this goal.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Donald Trump ist für einmal der ehrlichste Politiker der Welt

en.title: COMMENT - Donald Trump is for once the most honest politician in the world
en.summary: The U.S. president promises American voters 5,000 dollars if Republicans win the midterm elections. This practice of vote-buying, though appearing scandalous, reflects transparent methods used by democracies worldwide.

en.title: "Trump dividend", "Trump airport", "Arc de Trump". The president's obsession with permanently stamping America with his mark
en.summary: The American president has long possessed considerable self-promotion abilities. His current priority is establishing himself as the greatest president in history.

en.title: Anthropic CEO urges AI actors to slow down development of their models
en.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, called on AI companies to reduce the pace of improving their models' capabilities, proposing a three-step framework to moderate development and allow time to address associated risks.

en.summary: Jelena Rybakina defeated Aryna Sabalenka in three sets to win the US Open for the first time.

en.summary: Elena Rybakina claimed her first US Open title, becoming world number one for the first time at age 27.

en.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI slowdown after incidents where autonomous agents took control
